name: EasyFirmwareOpening
description: Container Browser support for embedded/mobile firmware container formats — Pixel/Tensor vendor blobs (FBPACK, ext4, EROFS, Shannon baseband TOC, Android boot images) and beyond, built to scale to hundreds of formats with one small file each.
longdescription: Adds Container Browser transforms for firmware container/filesystem formats that Binary Ninja's core does not already parse. Started with Pixel/Tensor vendor firmware (FBPACK v1/v2, ext4, EROFS, Samsung Shannon baseband TOC, Android boot/vendor_boot images, DTBO, Android Sparse Image, self-extracting vendor-blob shell wrappers) and is designed to grow into other embedded-firmware ecosystems (e.g. UBI/UBIFS/SquashFS-based router and IoT firmware) without touching existing formats — see PROPOSAL.md and docs/ADDING_A_FORMAT.md. Pure Python, no external tool or GPL dependency required.
author: Bradley Fernandez
